title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects open questions and answers them with web search
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout targets, licensing requirements and controls are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. It correctly distinguishes the planned proactive answers from existing prompted Q&A and reports Microsoft's conflicting statements about external meetings.

claims.claim: The roadmap associates this change with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365).
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Teams", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)"]

claims.claim: Microsoft plans for Facilitator to detect unanswered questions during Teams meetings.
claims.quote: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes Facilitator offering to look up an unanswered question such as 'What is an LLM?'.
claims.quote: When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer.

claims.claim: The roadmap says participants can select Yes to have Facilitator retrieve and share the answer.
claims.quote: Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified what Facilitator sends to the search service or confirmed the cited Copilot search privacy terms for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator web search generated queries Bing meeting conversation privacy data sent. Read microsoftteams/facilitator-teams, copilot/plan/manage-public-web-access and enterprise-data-protection search excerpts; none specifies Facilitator's generated queries.

claims.claim: The cited Copilot web-search page describes generated search queries being sent to Bing.
claims.quote: Based on these terms, Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: That page excludes generated web search queries from the Data Protection Addendum.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum (DPA) doesn't apply to the use of generated web search queries in Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Chat, or the Bing search service.

claims.claim: The Facilitator Purview page lists data loss prevention as unsupported.
claims.quote: | Data loss prevention | **✕** |

claims.claim: The Facilitator Purview page lists sensitivity labels as unsupported for AI interactions.
claims.quote: | Sensitivity labels | **✕** |

claims.claim: Purview DLP can block Copilot web searches when prompts contain sensitive information.
claims.quote: Restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork from using external web search when prompts contain sensitive data.

claims.claim: The Copilot DLP web-search policy is not confirmed to cover Facilitator.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "DLP" "web search". Read purview/ai-teams-facilitator (DLP unsupported) and purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about (Copilot, Chat and Cowork scope); neither confirms Facilitator coverage.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Allow web search in Copilot is a Cloud Policy control for Copilot web-search availability.
claims.quote: The primary way that IT admins can control access to web search is by using the Allow web search in Copilot policy, which is available only in Cloud Policy service for Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: For the listed commercial scope, unconfigured Allow web search in Copilot leaves web search available unless additional optional connected experiences are disabled.
claims.quote: If the IT admin doesn't configure the Allow web search in Copilot policy, web search will be available to users in both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat, unless the IT admin has set the Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office policy to Disabled.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Apps admin center route to policy configuration is Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings.
claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. ... On the Policy configurations page, select Create. ... Start with the basics ... Choose the scope ... On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors supports applying the desired web-search baseline once.
claims.quote: Create a new configurationMonitor object that runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in monitorOnly mode, or applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.

claims.claim: The Graph mechanism is preview beta and is not supported for production use.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Setting mode to applyOnce applies the baseline once rather than only monitoring.
claims.quote: An active applyOnce monitor runs in the background on behalf of the signed-in administrator and then becomes inactive.

claims.claim: The baseline resource type for web search is microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch"

claims.claim: The allowwebsearch resource uses resourceVersion 1.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch", "resourceVersion": 1

claims.claim: The web-search setting is carried by the string properties.value.
claims.quote: The value property is a string, not a Boolean or a number. ... "properties": { "value": "0" }

claims.claim: The string value 0 enables web search in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: `0` enables it in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The string value 1 disables web search in both Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: `1` disables it in both.

claims.where: Governance controls: Graph value meanings; Open questions
claims.claim: The string value 2 disables web search in Copilot Work mode while leaving Web mode and Copilot Chat enabled.
claims.quote: `2` disables it in Microsoft 365 Copilot Work mode while enabling it in Microsoft 365 Copilot Web mode and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: TCM supports these Cloud Policy settings only in tenant-level policies.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: TCM operations fail for a resource whose target setting is configured in a group-level policy.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: The TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite for allowwebsearch applyOnce.
claims.quote: Grant the delegated workload permissions to the TCM service principal. ... microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch | CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite | AI Administrator

claims.claim: The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All for applyOnce.
claims.quote: Creating an applyOnce monitor supports delegated permissions only. In addition to the calling app's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission, the TCM service principal needs delegated permissions for the target workloads

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the documented role for the signed-in user applying the Copilot web-search resource.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, AI Administrator is the least-privileged Microsoft Entra role for the signed-in user. This role requirement applies to the user, not to the TCM service principal.

claims.claim: The notice names the Copilot web search setting but not the specific Allow web search in Copilot policy or its Work-mode option.
claims.quote: The feature depends on the Copilot web search setting. If web search is disabled, responses are not generated.

claims.claim: The cited Facilitator retention route is Microsoft Purview portal > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft Purview portal, navigate to Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies and create a retention policy

claims.claim: New-RetentionComplianceRule -Policy <policy name> -RetentionDuration <days> -RetentionComplianceAction Keep adds a retaining rule with a duration in days.
claims.quote: New-RetentionComplianceRule -Name InternalCompanyRule -Policy "Internal Company Policy" -RetentionDuration Unlimited -RetentionComplianceAction Keep ... An integer: The hold duration in days.

claims.claim: Facilitator AI interactions in meetings are retained using a retention policy with the Teams chats location.
claims.quote: For Facilitator AI interactions in meetings, use a retention policy with the Teams chats option.

claims.claim: The retention rule is added to an existing policy identified by the Policy parameter.
claims.quote: The retention rule must be added to an existing retention policy using the Policy parameter.

claims.claim: The retention rule's Name parameter is required by the reference.
claims.quote: The Name parameter specifies a unique name for the retention rule. ... Default ... Mandatory: True

claims.claim: New-RetentionCompliancePolicy creates a retention policy that also requires a rule created using New-RetentionComplianceRule.
claims.quote: Use the New-RetentionCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create new retention policies and new retention label policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Creating a new policy also requires use of the New-RetentionComplianceRule cmdlet.

claims.claim: Learn's Facilitator allow/block instructions require Teams admin credentials.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Teams admin center with your Teams admin credentials.

claims.claim: Learn documents an Allow or Block action for Facilitator in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Facilitator is blocked if all apps are blocked for the organisation.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default. However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: Learn describes app permission policies and app-centric management for allowing Facilitator to selected users.
claims.quote: Follow the instructions at Use app permission policies to control user access to apps to create a new app policy for Facilitator. ... Follow the instructions at Add or modify app availability for users to assign the policy to users using app-centric management.

claims.claim: For migrated tenants, app availability is edited through Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Users and groups > Availability > Edit availability.
claims.quote: Go to the Manage apps page. ... select the app name to open its app details page. ... Select the Users and groups tab. ... select Availability. ... Select Edit availability.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp is documented for managing app availability.
claims.quote: This cmdlet allows administrators to modify app state, availability and installation status by adding or removing users and groups or changing assignment type or installation status.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsAppPermissionPolicy warns that app permission policies must be created and modified in the admin center, rather than with that cmdlet.
claims.quote: do not use this cmdlet. We require that all creation and modification of app permission polices (not including the assignment or removal of policies from users) happens in the Microsoft Teams & Skype for Business Admin Center

claims.claim: Blocking the Facilitator app restricts Facilitator as a whole, not only its proactive question-answering skill.
claims.quote: As an admin, you control whether Facilitator is available to your entire organization or to a certain group of users. ... To allow or block Facilitator for users, complete the following steps:
